svg.title: Kurukshetra — Ember Rite level blueprint
svg.desc: Show the boatyard crossing to threaten either site, or commit the carrier to a quicker outer bank and give up the short switch between sites. North is up. Two scaled site details and a floor elevation section accompany the plan.
